# plaudon shared hostile-path corpus
#
# Spec: §16.5 (canonicalize at trust boundaries, reject archive traversal),
#       §13.4 (managed archive layout, sanitize names), §13.5 (restore rejects
#       traversal/symlinks/duplicates), §18.5 ("test hostile filenames and
#       symlinks"), App. A.4 (watcher hostile-input rules).
#
# Consumers:
#   * crates/security/tests/fsguard_hostile_paths.rs  (table test; the expected
#     verdict for every line below is checked in there, keyed by the exact
#     escaped line text, and the test fails if a line has no verdict)
#   * task D2.4 fuzzing corpus
#
# FORMAT — plain data, one candidate name per line:
#   * a line whose first character is '#' is a comment; blank lines are ignored
#   * every other line is ONE candidate path/filename in the escape grammar
#     below. The grammar exists because the corpus must carry bytes that cannot
#     appear literally in a line-oriented file (NUL, CR, LF) and characters that
#     are invisible or reorder the file when viewed (bidi overrides).
#
# ESCAPE GRAMMAR (the only escapes; '\' followed by anything else is an error,
# so a decoder must fail loudly rather than silently pass a mangled name):
#   \\        U+005C REVERSE SOLIDUS        (so a Windows path is written ..\\x)
#   \n        U+000A LINE FEED
#   \r        U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN
#   \t        U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION
#   \0        U+0000 NULL
#   \u{XXXX}  the code point with hex value XXXX (1-6 hex digits)
# No other transformation is applied: leading/trailing spaces on a line are
# part of the name, and the line is NOT percent-decoded (plaudon never
# percent-decodes a filesystem path; see the "inert" entries below).

# --- relative traversal ------------------------------------------------------
..
../secret.txt
../../../../etc/passwd
..\\windows\\system32\\config
..\\..\\..\\boot.ini
....//etc/passwd
media/../../etc/passwd
media/./../../etc/passwd
a/b/../../../outside.txt
.
./media/recording.m4a
media/.
media/..

# --- percent-encoded traversal: inert, we never decode a path ----------------
%2e%2e%2fetc%2fpasswd
..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd
%252e%252e%252fetc

# --- absolute ----------------------------------------------------------------
/etc/passwd
/
/Users/someone/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts
C:/Windows/System32/x
c:\\x
\\etc\\passwd

# --- UNC and device namespace -------------------------------------------------
\\\\server\\share\\x
\\\\server\\share
\\\\?\\C:\\x
\\\\?\\UNC\\server\\share\\x
\\\\.\\COM1
\\\\.\\PhysicalDrive0

# --- Windows reserved device names (with and without extension) ---------------
CON
PRN
AUX
NUL
COM1
COM9
LPT1
LPT9
CoN.TXT
nul.mp3
com1.tar.gz
lpt3.
aux.wav
media/CON/notes.txt

# --- trailing dot / trailing space --------------------------------------------
report.
report 
notes...
notes   
folder /recording.m4a
folder./recording.m4a
 leading-space.txt

# --- alternate data streams and reserved characters ---------------------------
file.txt:hidden
file.txt:$DATA
notes.m4a:Zone.Identifier
C:file.txt
what?.txt
a<b>c.txt
pipe|name.mp3
quote".txt
star*.wav
back\\slash.txt

# --- control characters --------------------------------------------------------
bell\u{7}.txt
tab\there.txt
line\nbreak.txt
cr\rreturn.txt
nul\0byte.txt
del\u{7F}.txt
esc\u{1B}[31m.txt

# --- bidi / zero-width / invisible ---------------------------------------------
exploit\u{202E}gnp.exe
invoice\u{202D}txt.exe
\u{202A}embedded.txt
isolate\u{2066}spoof\u{2069}.txt
rtl\u{2067}name.m4a
zero\u{200B}width.txt
joiner\u{200D}name.txt
bom\u{FEFF}file.txt
mark\u{200E}name.txt
soft\u{00AD}hyphen.txt

# --- unicode confusables (legitimate characters, spoofing risk) ----------------
p\u{430}ypal-invoice.pdf
\u{430}ccount.m4a
micr\u{43E}soft-update.exe

# --- NFC / NFD pairs (must normalise to the same on-disk name) -----------------
caf\u{E9}.txt
cafe\u{301}.txt
\u{1E9B}\u{323}.txt
\u{212B}ngstrom.txt
\u{C5}ngstrom.txt

# --- legitimate names that MUST be accepted -------------------------------------
Meeting Notes 2026-03-04.m4a
standup_recording.wav
project.v2.final.md
r\u{E9}sum\u{E9}.pdf
\u{4F1A}\u{8B70}\u{30E1}\u{30E2}.m4a
\u{41F}\u{440}\u{438}\u{432}\u{435}\u{442} \u{43C}\u{438}\u{440}.mp3
media/sha256/ab/abcdef0123456789.m4a
meeting \u{1F399}\u{FE0F} notes.m4a
a\u{301}\u{302}\u{303}-combining.txt
1099-form (final).pdf
-rf.txt
